initial_claim: Deploying Feature Y is supported by a statistically significant 0.6% conversion lift (p = 0.03) worth about $12,000/month in revenue against $6,000/month in maintenance costs, yielding a positive net benefit.
defended_claim: The test observed a 0.6% conversion lift that was statistically significant (p = 0.03); using that observed lift, the estimated revenue impact is about $12,000/month versus about $6,000/month in maintenance costs, which supports an estimated net benefit rather than a guaranteed one.
